plan.notes:
Transcribed verbatim from the institution-published 'Music (B.A.) – Typical Plan' (2023-2024 AMU Academic Catalog, official PDF, p.229). Term-by-term sequence exactly as published; nothing rearranged. Prerequisites from course descriptions are not transcribed; prereq arrays are empty. Choice slots use the catalog's own slot labels as codes. Full course titles taken from the catalog's Course Descriptions (the plan abbreviates some). IMPORTANT: the catalog's printed semester totals sum to 128.5 credits (Class Piano courses carry 0.5 credit), so total_credits is seeded at the honest sum 128.5. Footnotes as printed: students who begin the major in sophomore year may register for two-credit versions of ensembles; majors must complete at least six ensemble credits for the degree.
allow_repeated_courses:true — the catalog's Typical Plan genuinely requires 'MUSC 111-115 Applied Lessons' (1 cr) in every one of the 8 semesters (1 or 2 credits in semesters 3-4 per the catalog's sophomore-start footnote); same precedent as ATU music plans (wave 13).
